title: 生物科学的生活方式
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/08_APB - A Bioscience Way of Life.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/08_APB - A Bioscience Way of Life/src.py

points.K2: 从上一课到日常生物技术
points.K8: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
points.K10: 生物技术的未来与伦理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在餐桌旁，桌上有番茄、玉米、牛奶和一件棉T恤
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a table with tomatoes, corn, a glass of milk and a folded cotton T-shirt, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看看身边的生物技术。

shots.scene: 粮食、能源、环境、健康四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a wheat ear, a fuel drop with a leaf, a globe with a recycling arrow, and a medical cross. No people.
shots.narration: 粮食、能源、环境、健康，都离不开它。

shots.scene: 阿杰吃着早饭，穿着棉T恤，嘟囔生物技术离自己很远
shots.prompt_en: The young male student eats breakfast in a cotton T-shirt and shrugs, as if biotechnology has nothing to do with him.
shots.narration: 阿杰觉得，生物技术离自己很远。

shots.scene: 小研指着他的早餐和衣服笑了
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points at his breakfast plate and his cotton shirt.
shots.narration: 小研笑了：你身上就有。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们来找找身边的生物技术。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白笔记本，旁边是暂停、回放图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank notebook and a pen, next to pause and replay icons.
shots.narration: 边看边记，需要时暂停回看。

shots.section_title: 从上一课到日常生物技术
shots.scene: 检测板、育种选择、诊断报告三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a test plate with colored wells, a row of animals with one highlighted, and a blank medical report. No people.
shots.narration: 上一课，做过检测，学过育种和诊断。
overlay: 从上一课到日常生物技术

shots.section_title: 从上一课到日常生物技术
shots.scene: 王老师在讲台前，屏幕上是房子和购物车图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at the front of a classroom with a house and shopping cart icon on a blank screen.
shots.narration: 这一课，看看生活里的生物技术。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐着回想，头顶气泡里是闹钟、早饭、公交车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk thinking, a thought bubble above him showing an alarm clock, breakfast and a bus.
shots.narration: 先回想：今天起床后，你做了什么？

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白清单上逐条写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes a list on a blank sheet of paper.
shots.narration: 暂停一下，把它们写成一张清单。

shots.scene: 番茄、大豆、土豆、玉米、牛奶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tomato, soybeans, a potato, an ear of corn and a glass of milk. No people.
shots.narration: 番茄、大豆、土豆、玉米、牛奶，

shots.scene: 棉花、乙醇燃料、甲烷、生物柴油、胰岛素瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cotton boll, a fuel can with a leaf, a gas flame, a biodiesel pump and a small insulin vial. No people.
shots.narration: 棉花、燃料，还有药物胰岛素，

shots.scene: 阿杰对照清单打勾，惊讶地睁大眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks items on his list against the icons and opens his eyes wide in surprise.
shots.narration: 都和生物技术有关。你用过哪些？

shots.scene: 吃、穿、出行三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fork and spoon, a T-shirt and a bus. No people.
shots.narration: 吃的、穿的、坐的，还能补充吗？

shots.scene: 地球仪上一些地区颜色深、一些地区颜色浅
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon with some regions colored deep red and others pale yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 世界各地，食物能量的供应很不均衡。

shots.scene: 空碗和瘦小的人形剪影图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an empty bowl next to a thin person silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 营养不良，是全球最大的健康难题，

shots.scene: 营养不良图标比几个疾病图标都大
shots.prompt_en: An icon comparison: a large empty bowl icon next to several smaller disease germ icons. No people.
shots.narration: 国际组织说：比任何单一疾病都普遍。

shots.scene: 天气、价格、土地几个原因图标连到空碗
shots.prompt_en: Several cause icons, such as drought, price tags and a small field, linked by arrows to an empty bowl. No people.
shots.narration: 原因很多，有些更容易改善。

shots.scene: 人群图标变多，农田图标却不变
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a crowd growing larger next to a farm field icon that stays the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 人口在增长，耕地却有限。

shots.scene: 抗虫叶片、营养强化、增产三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a leaf with a bug crossed out, a grain with a plus sign, and a taller stack of harvest crates. No people.
shots.narration: 抗虫、营养强化、提高产量，

shots.scene: 水滴和肥料袋图标，旁边向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a water drop and a fertilizer bag with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 还能减少用水和化肥。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在课桌前讨论，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student discuss at a desk with a big question mark between them.
shots.narration: 暂停想想，再和同学讨论转基因食品。

shots.scene: 油桶和气罐图标，指针指向见底
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an oil barrel and a gas tank with a gauge needle near empty. No people.
shots.narration: 石油和天然气，总有用完的一天。

shots.scene: 玉米变燃料、粪肥变沼气、油菜籽变柴油的三组箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three arrow icons: corn turning into a fuel can, manure turning into a gas flame, and rapeseed turning into a fuel pump. No people.
shots.narration: 生物技术能产乙醇、沼气和生物柴油。

shots.scene: 阿杰在笔记本上画了一片叶子和一个电池
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a leaf and a battery in his notebook.
shots.narration: 还有别的办法吗？暂停记下来。

shots.section_title: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
shots.scene: 海面上的围油栏和小清污船
shots.prompt_en: A floating oil boom around a dark patch on the sea with a small cleanup boat nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 生物修复，就是请微生物来清理污染，
overlay: 生物技术与环境：生物修复

shots.section_title: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
shots.scene: 微生物图标把黑色油滴变成水滴和气泡
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon microbe icons turning black oil droplets into clear water drops and bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 把污染物变成无害的物质。

shots.section_title: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
shots.scene: 化学品桶泄漏到地面的图标，旁边微生物
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a leaking chemical drum on soil with microbe icons nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 能处理油污，也能处理化学品泄漏。

shots.section_title: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
shots.scene: 洗衣液和洗洁精桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank laundry detergent jug and a blank dish soap bottle with enzyme sparkles. No people.
shots.narration: 含酶洗涤剂，也是小小的生物技术。

shots.section_title: 生物技术与环境：生物修复
shots.scene: 欣欣歪着头，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot tilts its head beside a question mark.
shots.narration: 你觉得，它还能用在哪里？

shots.scene: 诊断试剂盒和显微镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank diagnostic test kit and a microscope. No people.
shots.narration: 在健康领域，诊断更快更准，

shots.scene: 不同的人形图标配不同的药丸
shots.prompt_en: Several different person silhouettes each matched with a different pill icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用药可以因人而异，

shots.scene: 靶心上的药丸图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pill hitting the center of a target. No people.
shots.narration: 新药更有针对性。

shots.scene: 细胞工厂产出药瓶的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a cell icon with a small factory roof producing blank medicine vials. No people.
shots.narration: 改造生物来生产药物，叫生物制药，

shots.scene: 胰岛素小瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small blank insulin vial and a pen-style injector. No people.
shots.narration: 胰岛素，就是这样生产的。

shots.section_title: 生物技术的未来与伦理
shots.scene: 欣欣望向一条通往远方的道路，路边有问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks down a road leading into the distance with question marks along the way.
shots.narration: 生物技术的下一步，会是什么？
overlay: 生物技术的未来与伦理

shots.section_title: 生物技术的未来与伦理
shots.scene: 天平一边是需求图标，一边是伦理图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a people icon on one side and a heart-and-shield icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 伦理和需求，会怎样影响未来？

shots.section_title: 生物技术的未来与伦理
shots.scene: 阿杰暂停视频，在笔记本上写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps pause on a blank tablet and writes in his notebook.
shots.narration: 暂停一下，写下你的想法。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处高亮的空白条
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook page with three highlighted blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 看完标出三个要点，

shots.scene: 新旧两个笔记本用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Two notebook icons connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 想想和学过的知识有什么联系，

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问就问老师，笔记要保管好。

shots.scene: 几个锥形瓶里油和水分层，旁边微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Several conical flasks with a layer of oil floating on water, with microbe icons beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 下一个项目：测试吃油微生物的效果。

shots.scene: 温度计、酸碱、盐三个条件图标
shots.prompt_en: Three condition icons: a thermometer, a pH strip and a salt shaker. No people.
shots.narration: 看看不同条件下，它们干得怎么样。

shots.scene: 工厂和自然界图标之间的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow linking a natural pond icon to a factory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 理解自然过程怎样变成工业应用。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评分表讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank grading sheet and explains the project to the class.
shots.narration: 要求和评分标准，听老师安排。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现粮食、能源、环境、健康图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of wheat, a fuel drop, a globe and a medical cross.
shots.narration: 生物技术，改变着吃穿用和健康。

shots.scene: 微生物把油滴变成水滴的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of microbes turning oil droplets into clean water drops. No people.
shots.narration: 生物修复，请微生物清理污染。

shots.scene: 诊断试剂盒和胰岛素瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank diagnostic test kit and a small insulin vial. No people.
shots.narration: 诊断更准，药物更精准。

shots.scene: 天平和锥形瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a balance scale and conical flasks with oil and water layers. No people.
shots.narration: 想想伦理与需求，再做生物修复项目。

shots.scene: 欣欣在一盆绿植和一个地球仪旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a green potted plant and a globe.
shots.narration: 生物技术就在身边，下次见！
